scripts.build: echo 'No build needed for Node.js backend'
scripts.check-deps: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const deps = ['dotenv', 'express', 'cors', 'helmet', 'express-async-errors', 'express-rate-limit', 'jsonwebtoken', 'bcryptjs', '@prisma/client']; const missing = deps.filter(d => !fs.existsSync('./node_modules/' + d)); if(missing.length) { console.error('❌ Missing dependencies:', missing); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('✅ All dependencies present'); }"
scripts.prisma:generate:safe: npx prisma generate 2>&1 || (echo '⚠️ Prisma generate failed, trying fallback' && true)
